for: volcodec_ng lossless zarr chunk codec PR (#2232), speed chart (22 Oct)
shows: size ratio (raw / stored) and one-thread encode and decode MB/s of four lossless options (vc-delta3d 0.2.0 LPC, vc-delta3d delta, volcodec_ng, volcomp 1.3.0 q 0) on 12 held-out 256^3 CT crops, pooled, and the size ratio by scan resolution
kind: chart of measured results, numbers only (no CT pixels)

data.note: 12 crops of 256^3 voxels from 10 public scans at 0.55, 1.13, 2.4 and 8.64 um voxels (3 crops each), chosen by a fixed rule after the codec was frozen; every codec decoded every crop exactly
data.credit: Data: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0

code.codecs: vc-delta3d 0.2.0 (103b502a, Predictor::Lpc and the default Predictor::Delta, quant 1), volcodec_ng lossless (the header in this PR), volcomp 1.3.0 at q 0 (villa's libs/volcomp)
code.speeds: one thread, MB/s of raw voxels (1e6 voxels per MB), best of 3, all four in one run (22 Oct 2026, 14:33 to 14:37 UTC) on a shared 4-core Xeon cloud container with AVX2, gcc 13.3.0 -O3
